note:
**Derby House, 1 Derby Terrace, on the 1911 census - a boarding house of thirteen, and the first household the record has ever held at this property.** Transcribed by A. Hagues from the return.

**Sarah Wilkinson is the same woman the 1901 census gives at Beechwood on Hamilton Drive** - 52 then and 62 here, a widow born at Burnaston in Derbyshire both times - and here her trade is written out: **boarding house keeper**. Her four servants are entered as cook, kitchen maid and housemaids *of the boarding house*, so there is no doubt what the establishment was.

**That settles what the 1901 page was doing.** The Beechwood household had been read as two - Sarah with four children, and a separate group of nine that carried no head and began with somebody entered as a boarder. It is one household: she is the head and the nine are her lodgers. See [[1901-house-names-not-in-the-record]].

**She moved between the censuses.** Beechwood is on Hamilton Drive and Derby House on Derby Terrace, so these are two premises rather than one renamed, and Beechwood still wants a number.

**Florence's age is wrong on this page.** It gives 30, which would put her birth in 1881; the 1939 register gives her birth date as **4 June 1874**. She is bound by number to the Florence of the 1901 household rather than created again, on A. Hagues's reading that they are one woman.

**Several readings on this page are doubtful and are left as questions rather than tidied away.** Arthur L Hicks's birthplace reads *"Ludia Panjab (Resident)"* and his occupation *"Valmer"* - the first is very likely India, Punjab, and the second is not a word. A St George Ranvall's occupation reads *"Vaener"*, and the surname itself is uncertain. Julia Moult is born at *"Hollaton"*, which is no Nottinghamshire village; Halloughton and Hoveringham are both nearer the sound of it. Where the page is merely misspelt - Draughtman, Driector, Kingston On Sour, Whiton - the word is written out properly and the original recorded in the source line.

**One servant shares a name with somebody already in the record.** Julia Moult here was born about 1864; the Julia Moult the record holds (#1388) was born about 1872. Eight years apart, so a different woman, and she is created rather than bound.
source: 1911 census return for Derby House, 1 Derby Terrace, Nottingham, transcribed by A. Hagues.
